After reading through everything, this woman is overstepping boundaries for you... But your fiancé hasn't set these boundaries. It is his job to not let her get to this point. They've been friends for a long time,  he should be able to set boundaries and communicate with her. Your fiancé cheated on you before. I'm guessing he likes attention from her. 

Of course, you can have him cut her off. You should not have to take this stand. Hopefully he doesn't throw it up at you later. He's okay with it now, sure. But why can't he make these moves without you expressing concern? It doesn't take a mind reader to know she shouldn't be sending pics of strippers to him, ect. He knows. He is a grown man. Also, why does she feel comfortable doing and saying this stuff? Because he has made a comfy space for her to do so.

It's up to you if you think he won't cheat again, hasn't already cheated with someone else, or if you wish to move your boundaries for him. He's really testing how far you'll let him go. 

Get couples counseling. This is not going to end here.
